data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Maneka is considered a divine name connected to the goddess Lakshmi, who is the deity of wealth, fortune, and prosperity. It is a name that invokes positivity, hope, and a sense of connection to the divine.

historical_references.reference: Maneka was a queen of the Mauryan Empire in the 3rd century BCE, famous for her beauty and her patronage of Jainism. She was the wife of Emperor Ashoka and is mentioned in the Ashokan inscriptions.
Maneka was a Hindu goddess, corresponding to the Greek goddess Aphrodite. She was worshipped in medieval India and was believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
